# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| 2.1.x   | Yes       |
| < 2.1   | No        |

Security fixes are provided for the latest 2.1.x release across all supported Minecraft version workspaces.

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not** open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities that could be exploited.

Instead, use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/jauml/security/advisories/new) on this repository.

Include:

- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact
- Steps to reproduce
- Affected Jauml version and Minecraft loader if relevant

We will acknowledge reports as soon as possible and work on a fix before any public disclosure. Please allow reasonable time for investigation and remediation before discussing the issue elsewhere.

## Scope

This policy covers the Jauml library mod source code and published artifacts in this repository. It does not cover third-party mods that depend on Jauml or vulnerabilities in Minecraft, mod loaders, or their ecosystems.
